blocks.text: Virtualization aisi technology hai jis se ek physical (asal) machine par kai virtual machines chal sakti hain. Yeh jadu ki tarah hai: ek asal computer kai alag alag computers ki tarah kaam karne lagta hai. Sochiye aap ke paas ek taqatwar computer hai; virtualization se aap us ke andar kai “virtual” computers bana sakte hain. Har virtual computer apna operating system aur apni applications chala sakta hai, bilkul aise jaise woh alag machine ho. Is se hardware ka behtar istemal hota hai, kharcha kam hota hai, aur intezam aasan aur lachakdar (flexible) ho jata hai.
Yani ek computer kai computers ban jata hai, aur kam cheezon se zyada kaam ho jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Virtualization cloud provider ka paisa kaise bachati hai?
blocks.explanation: Ek taqatwar server par kai customers ki virtual machines chal sakti hain, is liye provider ko kam physical machines khareedni, chalani aur sambhalni parti hain.

items: Virtualization: ek physical machine par kai virtual machines, har ek ka apna OS aur apps.
Faide: hardware ka behtar istemal, kam kharcha, aasan intezam.
